sentences.text:
Sharad Kulshreshtha vs State Of U.P. And Another on 3 June,
2024

Bench: Ajit Kumar
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:100798
Court No. - 67
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 18651 of 2024
Applicant :- Sharad Kulshreshtha

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Prasad Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajit Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and perused the material on record.
2 . The applicant before this Court is husband of the informant namely, the second respondent.
He has been chargesheeted alongwith other members of the family who are stated to be already on bail.

On earlier round of litigation the matter was sent for the mediation to be arrived at between the parties but mediation report has been filed way back in the year 2020 and thus the proceedings got reinitiated.
The petitioner is said to be not answering the summons and resultantly has been issued with a non bailable warrant on 21.10.2022 and that was reiterated on 05.01.2023 and has been continuing as such.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant before this Court is ready to surrender and apply for regular bail provided he is given atleast some respite in terms of two weeks'
time.
It is also undertaken on behalf of the applicant that the applicant would not be seeking any further opportunity in the matter.

4. Learned AGA for the State has sought to oppose this application on the ground that non bailable warrant has been continuing since last two years and applicant has been avoiding deliberately appearance before the Court.

5. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and looking to the facts and circumstances of the case as arises out of matrimonial dispute where mediation proceedings had already been drawn and family members of the applicant are already on bail in connection with the same case, it is hereby provided and by way of last opportunity that, if applicant appears on or before 18.06.2024 before the court concerned and applies for bail, his bail application shall be considered in accordance with law and shall be disposed of accordingly.
6.

Till 18.06.2024, no coercive action shall be taken to arrest the application pursuant to the non bailable warrant issued in Case No.1688 of 2016 (Smt. Deeksha Kulshreshtha v. Sharad Kulsheshtha) pending in the court on Chief Judicial Magistrate, Etah under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.Act, P.S.- Kotwali Nagar, District Etah.

8. With the aforesaid observations and directions, this petition stands disposed of.
